operating_notes.text: Q4FY26 consolidated revenue reached 2,676.2 Cr with a net loss of 219.11 Cr due to treasury losses.
Q4FY26 consolidated revenue was ₹2,676.20 Cr with a net loss of ₹219.11 Cr driven by negative fair value changes of ₹716.57 Cr.
MOAMC received PFRDA approval to act as a Sponsor of Pension Fund under the NPS.
Annuity businesses contribute over 60% of total revenues.
AMC net flow market share was 4.2% in Q1FY27 versus 3.7% in the previous quarter, against an AUM market share of 2.9%.
Private wealth wallet size per client is close to ₹25 Cr and AUM per banker close to ₹550 Cr, with 441 RMs of whom only 32% have over 3 years' vintage.
The wealth management loan book rose 33% YoY to over ₹7,000 Cr, with MTF market share close to 6.5% and the MTF book up 54% YoY.

predictions.kpi: Housing finance credit cost normalising toward FY26's 0.5%

timeline.summary: Motilal Oswal received requests from 11 promoter group members holding 0.42% to reclassify to the public category.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,676.2 Cr (+121.4% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹221.28 Cr (against a loss of ₹64.77 Cr a year earlier).
Motilal Oswal Financial Services reported Q4FY26 operating PAT of ₹661 Cr, up 25% YoY, and FY26 operating PAT of ₹2,360 Cr.
Motilal Oswal Financial Services reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,676.20 Cr and a net loss of ₹219.11 Cr due to fair value losses, alongside a full-year FY26 PAT of ₹1,872.46 Cr.
Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4 & FY 2025-26 earnings conference call on April 30, 2026, via its website.
Motilal Oswal Asset Management Company received PFRDA approval to act as a Sponsor of Pension Fund under the National Pension System.
Motilal Oswal Financial Services reported FY26 operating PAT of ₹2,360 Cr (+16% YoY) and Asset & Private Wealth AUM of ₹3.7 lakh Cr.
Motilal Oswal incorporated its wholly-owned step-down subsidiary, Motilal Oswal Pension Fund Management Limited, on June 4, 2026.
On its 24 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, Motilal Oswal reported operating PAT up 14% YoY to ₹609 Cr, with asset management at 40% of group operating profit and AMC average AUM at ₹1.81 lakh Cr.
